digest.component_or_area: dependency graph resolver and link validation
propositions: rebar link can silently record a different edge than requested when cross-subtree links are auto-escalated, leaving the original child-level dependency unrecorded
A blocking edge can form between a ticket and its own ancestor or descendant, violating the ancestor invariant and distorting ready, next-batch, and parent-first cascade logic

The resolver incorrectly decides comparability from ticket TYPE_TIER instead of from structural position in the parent hierarchy, causing type-tier-mismatched siblings to be forbidden from holding direct dependencies
Legacy edges written under the type-tier rule must be detectable store-wide and repairable in a single pass without breaking the escalation contract callers depend on
The escalation contract auto-escalates cross-subtree links and emits a redirect record, but the record is silently discarded when quiet=True in library and MCP paths
